subject: Educational Psychology
stem: In a large group project, some students put in noticeably less individual effort than they would if working alone, relying on other group members to complete the work. This tendency for individual effort to decrease as group size increases is called:
explanation: Social loafing is the reduction of individual effort in group settings, especially when individual contributions are not clearly identifiable — a key challenge teachers must design around (e.g., assigning individual accountability) when using group work.
